Bash(node -e "const XLSX=require\('xlsx'\); const wb=XLSX.readFile\('C:/Users/huawei/OneDrive/Desktop/ملخص أرصده العملاء.xlsx'\); const ws=wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]]; const rows=XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json\(ws,{header:1,raw:true,defval:''}\); let nonZero=0,zero=0,neg=0,total=0,maxAbs=0; const samples={pos:[],neg:[],zero:[]}; for\(let i=2;i<rows.length;i++\){const name=rows[i][0]; const raw=String\(rows[i][1]||''\); const cleaned=raw.replace\(/SAR/gi,''\).replace\(/,/g,''\).replace\(/\\s/g,''\).trim\(\); const n=Number\(cleaned\); if\(!Number.isFinite\(n\)\){console.log\('WEIRD:', JSON.stringify\(rows[i]\)\); continue;} if\(n<0\){neg++; if\(samples.neg.length<3\)samples.neg.push\([name,raw,n]\); total+=n;} else if\(n>0\){nonZero++; if\(samples.pos.length<3\)samples.pos.push\([name,raw,n]\); total+=n;} else {zero++; if\(samples.zero.length<2\)samples.zero.push\([name,raw,n]\);} if\(Math.abs\(n\)>maxAbs\)maxAbs=Math.abs\(n\);} console.log\('positive:',nonZero,'negative:',neg,'zero:',zero,'total:',total.toFixed\(2\),'maxAbs:',maxAbs\); console.log\('pos samples:',samples.pos\); console.log\('neg samples:',samples.neg\); console.log\('zero samples:',samples.zero\); console.log\('last 3 rows:',rows.slice\(-3\)\);")
